description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs: Removing `Default for ValidationPolicy` forces every caller to supply a timestamp via `ValidationPolicy::new(now_unix)`. This eliminates the footgun where `Default::default()` silently creates a policy with `current_time_unix = 0` (1970-01-01), causing every modern certificate to fail validity checks. The struct-update idiom `..ValidationPolicy::new(0)` in tests (where `current_time_unix` is overridden anyway) is slightly awkward but acceptable — the dead `0` is immediately overwritten and the alternative is duplicating all fields.
title: Good: ValidationPolicy Default removal
